integrity: Analytical proof via full eigenspace decomposition and PBH; standalone exact modular finite verification corroborates but does not establish infinite cases. All publication dates are taken from verified first public-source records, not publication year.
scientific_limitations: Exact fixed-weight symmetric Laplacian controllability for \(n\ge3\), \(a>0\), \(b\ge0\); no assertion on numerical conditioning, energy, arbitrary edge weights or aggregated single-input actuation. Specialist prior-literature equivalence risk remains.
title: A matched-edge weight resonance and the full actuator-set polynomial of bipartite networks
